aboutGame.title: What is Digimon Alysion?
paragraphs: Digimon Alysion is Bandai's free-to-play online card game for mobile, set in the metaverse space Lacuna. Players enter the world through a full-dive T.A.L.E. headset, carry their collection in a D-STORAGE deck case, and battle in the in-world card game Digimon Liberator.

The campaign follows Kanata Hondo as she learns Digimon Liberator with her online friend Futre and crosses paths with Valner Dragnogh and the mysterious GEMMON. Digimon Alysion combines guided story battles, ranked play, card collecting, breeding, and deck building on iOS and Android.

modules.name: Digimon Alysion Beginner Guide
modules.description: Understand the game's core systems, card battle rules, basic controls, and Story Mode progression with a beginner-friendly walkthrough.

highlights.detail: Finish the guided tutorial and claim any available pre-registration rewards.
Read every card in the starter deck and identify its win condition.
Play three practice matches to learn the battle screen and turn flow.
Trim the deck to one evolution line and one clear strategy.
Open the free daily pack and log new cards for future builds.
Enter ranked or event play, then adjust three to five cards at a time.

modules.name: Digimon Alysion Card Battle Guide
modules.description: Learn the fundamental rules of Digimon card battles, deck-building concepts, card effects, and strategic decision-making.

highlights.label: Memory
highlights.detail: The shared memory gauge decides turn order; overspending hands the remainder to your opponent.

highlights.label: Digivolve
highlights.detail: Place higher-level cards on top of a Digimon so inherited effects support the stack.

highlights.label: Security
highlights.detail: Attacks chip the security stack, so applying pressure matters as much as building a board.

highlights.label: Breeding
highlights.detail: Eggs develop in the breeding area and can move into battle when the timing is right.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Digimon Alysion.

items.question: What is Digimon Alysion?
items.answer: Digimon Alysion is Bandai's free-to-play mobile online card game set in the metaverse space Lacuna. Players collect cards, build decks, and battle in the in-world game Digimon Liberator while following Kanata Hondo's story.

items.question: Is Digimon Alysion free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Digimon Alysion is free to download and play with optional in-app purchases. The game also offers a free daily pack that helps new players expand their collection without spending.

items.question: Do I need card game experience to play Digimon Alysion?
items.answer: No. Digimon Alysion includes a guided tutorial that teaches card layouts, card usage, shared memory, digivolution, and battle basics before you move into ranked play.

items.question: When can I play Digimon Alysion?
items.answer: Digimon Alysion is planned for release in 2026, and pre-registration is open on iOS and Android. Bandai has not announced a specific launch date, and pre-registration rewards arrive through in-game mail at release.

items.question: How does deck building work in Digimon Alysion?
items.answer: Digimon Alysion deck building starts with a focused 50-card deck built around one evolution line. Check the cost curve, keep enough cheap early plays, and test changes in blocks of matches before entering ranked play.
